scope: Exact upstream guards.js and one-hand constructor selection only. Two-hand estoc and corr-v2 omitted.
protocol: Native Fighter/Skill held/inputActive and handOffset deltas follow main frame hand input contract, no renderer/input event injection. B paired legacy, seed7,3s preparation,8s protocol; healthy standing only. Touch release is not physical dropSword. Actual user symptom is not proved reproduced.
torqueDefinition: sword.userTorque captured read-only immediately before native solver: total explicit controller torque, including any point-force moments; debug wrist torque is before twist, not final applied wrist torque.

pistolTapSmoke.method: Actual Skill.thrust six taps at1.2s intervals, native physics/combat gun; passive opponent, seed5,B/paired/legacy,7.5simseconds

liveDuels.protocol: Actual AI both fighters, walls, seed7,B paired legacy,20s each. Finite is not physical acceptance; geometry peaks are recorded separately.

before.method: Actual mobile landscape Start, stationary weapon-screen side drag to hand-map x≈.52 y≈.03 hold/release/retouch; AI update disabled only. Each hold/release/retouch settles for .4 live simulation seconds using normal RAF; no naturalness/performance acceptance.
